report.answer_text:
Erling Haaland holds the record for most goals in a single Premier League season. He scored 36 goals in 35 appearances for Manchester City in 2022-23.[1]
Previous record: Haaland's 36 goals surpassed the previous record of 34, shared by Alan Shearer and Andy Cole.[1] Those two set their records before the league was cut from 22 teams to 20 in 1995, so they played 42-game seasons instead of the current 38.[1]
Best before Haaland in a 38-game season: Mohamed Salah, with 32 goals for Liverpool in 2017–18.[2]
Haaland's record is still listed as current in the most recent sources I found.
